entities.name: El-Hajjâj
entities.description: Powerful wizard of Rabiah, father of Nailah, who discovered the prophecy of the One Made of Five.

entities.name: Thousand-fold Refraction
entities.description: Event that copied people, which El-Hajjâj possibly escaped.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: Daughter of El-Hajjâj who tried to force the Unification of Taysir.

entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: Nailah's lover, trained by El-Hajjâj and cursed by Nailah with leprosy.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Figure existing in five versions who would become the greatest planeswalker if united.

entities.name: One Made of Five
entities.description: Prophecy that united versions of Taysir become the greatest planeswalker.

entities.name: City in a Bottle
entities.description: Place where El-Hajjâj hid the blue Taysir.

events.summary: Nailah tried to force the Unification of Taysir; Hajjâj tried to stop her and was seemingly killed.
events.quote: When Nailah tried to force the Unification of Taysir and use his power for herself, Hajjâj tried to stop her but was seemingly killed.

events.summary: Hajjâj revealed he was still alive and aided Raghib and the white Taysir against Nailah.
events.quote: Hajjâj revealed he was still alive and aided the two of them against Nailah.

relations.quote: He was the father of Nailah

relations.note: Trained him in the arcane arts
relations.quote: trained both her and her lover Raghib in the arcane arts
